description: Read a request you hold a grant on: objective, attempts, facts, booking, your_scope and next_allowed. It checks any booking against the business calendar and updates the stored record and billing to match, but never books, moves or cancels anything and contacts nobody; repeat it freely. Use it after a booking, and after claim_request, before acting. Not for a conversation started without a request (get_replies). next_allowed is book, cancel, read or needs_human; a fact marked uncertain means the calendar could not confirm it. Refused with grant_required or grant_revoked when you have no live grant. Requires direct:tasks.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by open_request or shared by the assistant that opened it.

name: get_request
title: Read a request
